build: clickhouse local 26.10.2.103 (DataLakeCatalog database engine), release binary for Linux x86_64

catalog-login.note: ClickHouse lists the tables of each namespace, not the namespaces, so view_measurement, which holds only a view, is not listed.

views.note: ClickHouse's Iceberg REST catalog loads only tables, never views (src/Databases/DataLake/RestCatalog.cpp), so the view is an unknown table (UNKNOWN_TABLE).

incremental-read.note: ClickHouse reads an Iceberg table at one snapshot (iceberg_snapshot_id, iceberg_timestamp_ms) and has no incremental read between snapshots (clickhouse.com/docs/engines/table-engines/integrations/iceberg).
